image_description: A person viewed from the back wearing a black academic gown with wide, flowing sleeves and a blue velvet hood draped over the shoulders. The subject holds a white rolled document in their left hand. The background shows an indoor setting with a window and some greenery.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The garment clearly flows from the shoulders downwards with a loose, rectangular drape typical of academic regalia.
The image is taken from the rear view; the front opening and bilateral symmetry of the front panels are not visible.
The gown is loose-fitting and hides the specific shape of the torso and legs, consistent with the voluminous description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Wide open sleeves extending well below hand level.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The right sleeve is clearly visible hanging loosely and extends significantly past where the hand would be if the arm were straight down.
The subject is facing away from the camera, so the front closure is completely occluded.
A black garment (likely a suit jacket or formal shirt) is visible underneath the gown at the neck and shoulder area.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Heavy matte fabric typically black polyester or wool blend.

The fingers gripping the white scroll appear slightly fused and lack distinct knuckle definition, a common minor artifact in AI-generated hands.
